name: Do tiny home shells come with plumbing or electrical rough-ins?

mainEntity.name: Do tiny home shells come with plumbing or electrical rough-ins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our standard tiny home shells do not typically include plumbing or electrical rough-ins. This allows homeowners maximum flexibility to design and install these critical systems according to their specific needs, local codes, and chosen appliances. We provide a complete exterior shell, creating a weatherproof envelope ready for all interior work, including insulation, wiring, and plumbing. We can offer guidance on considerations for these systems during the design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tiny home shells from Zen Tiny Homes do not typically include plumbing or electrical rough-ins, allowing for owner customization.
